a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first means we both almost certainly die with empty units. The reserve already holds exactly 4. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me. Afterwards, if the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so you can get your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take any more, so the reserve can build up to 4 for you.
I'm operating now and will keep operating every round. All new cells are yours. Take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
